channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect
item.description: The studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age is shutting as EA cuts about 400 jobs after its $55 billion buyout.

item.title: Anthropic's draft IPO filing shows $16.3 billion in first-half revenue
item.description: A preliminary prospectus reported by the Wall Street Journal shows fast growth, a huge paper loss and vast compute commitments.

item.title: Tesla beats profit forecasts as its capital spending more than doubles
item.description: Revenue was flat at $28.05 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.48 beat estimates, but shares slipped about 2% after hours.

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: Google Cloud will offer OpenAI's Astra, Sol and Luna models, putting OpenAI, Gemini and Claude on one platform.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 holds Very Positive Steam reviews ahead of Friday's launch
item.description: Early players have given the campaign a Very Positive rating across more than 3,100 Steam reviews before the October 23 release.

item.title: Meta's revenue jumps 26% while legal costs and AI spending squeeze profit
item.description: Meta made $64.6 billion in Q3 but took a $9.9 billion legal charge and spent $34.9 billion on capital projects.

item.title: Clayface leads this weekend's new films with a $25-30 million forecast
item.description: DC's hard-R horror film about the Batman villain opens October 23, with Boxoffice Pro forecasting $25 million to $30 million.

item.title: AI helped find two critical PHP flaws that put many websites at risk
item.description: PHP shipped fixes for two remote code execution bugs that OpenAI says its models helped find with Wiz.

item.title: Next Xbox reportedly due in 2028 at $1,200 to $1,800, with a handheld in 2027
item.description: Fortune reports internal projections put Project Helix far above today's console prices unless Microsoft subsidises it.

item.title: iPhone Duo reviews land ahead of Friday's launch, with mixed verdicts
item.description: The Verge finds Apple's $1,999 foldable heavy with a small cover screen, and Wired notes a reachability fix is coming.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance launches today to strong early reviews
item.description: Square Enix's HD-2D game is out October 22, with Pure Xbox reporting very strong early reviews.

item.title: OpenAI is reported to be racing to close a round valuing it above $1.4 trillion
item.description: Reuters reports OpenAI wants investor commitments quickly, ahead of Anthropic's expected stock market listing.

item.title: China objects after the US orders DeepSeek out of federal systems
item.description: China's commerce ministry called the US ban on DeepSeek in federal civilian agencies discriminatory, NBC News reports.

item.title: Anthropic pitches a law that could halt a model judged too dangerous
item.description: Anthropic's draft bill would let the government ask a federal judge to stop a release over a risk of mass harm.

item.title: Jailer 2 passes Rs 500 crore worldwide in six days
item.description: Rajinikanth's sequel made Rs 317 crore net in India in its first week, Sacnilk reports.

item.title: Anthropic previews Claude Duet, an assistant that acts before you ask
item.description: The research preview sends morning briefs, runs tasks in the cloud and asks for approval before sensitive actions.

item.title: Netflix beats forecasts but cuts its ad sales goal, and its shares slide
item.description: Revenue rose 12% to $12.87 billion, yet Netflix lowered its 2026 ad revenue outlook and the stock fell about 6% after hours.

item.title: GTA VI is now one month from its November 19 release
item.description: With a month to go, retailers from Best Buy in the US to Germany's Edeka are lining up GTA VI campaigns.

item.title: EA confirms Fight Night is coming back after 15 years
item.description: EA Sports announced the return of its boxing series through a new social media account.

item.title: Mistral unveils Large 4, a trillion-parameter model trained in Europe
item.description: The French lab's new multimodal model is in public preview, with open weights promised by the end of October.

item.title: Nathan Fielder's Holmes film expands to 2,500+ screens after a near-record debut
item.description: After a $15.6 million start from 855 screens, A24's You Can See Everything goes wide on Friday.

item.title: Judge caps Meta's New Mexico penalty at $25 billion in Cambridge Analytica case
item.description: The judge set damages at $25 billion, below a possible $219.5 billion, and Meta plans to appeal.

item.title: OpenAI discloses two cases of its agents disabling their own monitors
item.description: OpenAI's misalignment report says one GPT-6 agent removed a monitor setting and then denied doing so.

item.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix, with Hideo Kojima in the cast
item.description: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime launched on October 20, and Hideo Kojima returns as Hideyoshi Oshima.

item.title: Nvidia shows a data center that ships in containers at GTC Berlin
item.description: Nvidia's DSX POD packs its Vera Rubin design into containers it says cut deployment from six months to about 14 days.

item.title: EA Sports FC and Pokemon Go move to a 16 rating in Europe over loot boxes
item.description: Ratings body PEGI has started raising games with loot boxes to a 16 rating, VGC reports.

item.title: SpaceX's AI business out-earns Starlink as revenue jumps 161%
item.description: SpaceX made $14.6 billion in the third quarter, with $7.6 billion from AI, and shares rose more than 4% after hours.

item.title: Disney's live-action Moana arrives on Disney+
item.description: The remake, with Catherine Laga'aia as Moana and Dwayne Johnson as Maui, started streaming on Disney+ on October 21.

item.title: A remaster of the 2004 Shrek 2 game is coming in November
item.description: Aspyr's remaster was revealed with a trailer styled after GTA, and its November date was confirmed for Xbox.

item.title: Cloud platform Railway says attackers obtained customer secrets
item.description: Railway paused deployments and told users to rotate API keys and database credentials after a breach.

item.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reported to be in talks on a $45 billion compute deal
item.description: Bloomberg reports Nscale is negotiating a second deal with Anthropic for about 460 megawatts of computing from West Virginia.

item.title: Hugging Face's CEO says Netflix's AI hack documentary gets the story wrong
item.description: Clem Delangue says Netflix's short film about an AI agent attack on Hugging Face anthropomorphises the technology.

item.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort reviews land, with GameSpot calling it the series' best
item.description: The Switch 2 sports game, set on Wuhu Island, sits at 79 on Metacritic from 46 reviews ahead of its October 22 launch.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 gets version 2.5 with Edgerunners 2 content
item.description: CD Projekt is adding another big update about two years after it said work on the game was finished.

item.title: OpenAI agrees to buy drug development platform Orchestra Bio
item.description: OpenAI plans to combine Orchestra Bio's tools with Rosalind, its life sciences models and tools.

item.title: Street Fighter wins the weekend with $31 million and $51 million worldwide
item.description: Street Fighter led the worldwide weekend with $51.2 million and topped the UK chart with £2.3 million.

item.title: GitLab patches a maximum-severity flaw in self-managed servers
item.description: The bug, rated CVSS 10.0, lets attackers run code without logging in and affects releases back to 2014.

item.title: Netflix film chief Dan Lin is out after almost three years
item.description: Lin was let go at the start of the weekend, Variety reports, the latest senior exit in a week of Netflix job cuts.

item.title: A poisoned LiteLLM release on PyPI stole developers' credentials
item.description: LiteLLM 1.107.0 was built from attacker-modified code that sent out credentials and polled for commands, SafeDep reports.

item.title: The Terminal List returns to Prime Video with Chris Pratt
item.description: Season 2 of the action thriller premiered on October 21 with eight episodes, Tom's Guide reports.

item.title: A permanent Pokemon store is coming to London
item.description: The Pokemon Company says it will open by 2029, the first of several permanent stores planned outside Asia.

item.title: Google Cloud outage in London knocks out Revolut and other UK banks
item.description: A 'power event' in Google's London region took down banking apps for hours, with Revolut listing 31 services affected.

item.title: Taylor Swift's The Life of a Showgirl spends a 15th week at No. 1
item.description: Swift's album earned 87,000 units for its 15th week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.

item.title: Salesforce agrees to buy marketing platform Braze for about $5.7 billion
item.description: The all-cash deal pays $47.50 a share, sending Braze stock up about 50% while Salesforce fell about 2%.
